notes.title: April Leader Board Coming on 01/04/2025
notes.notes:
Dear Guards,
 
First of all, I admire your dedication to guarding the button. You are a perfect example of not all heroes wearing capes. You are the heroes we did not know we needed, wanted or had, the protectors, the humble servants to the planet itself.

Now to get to the announcement. A new leaderboard will open on 01/04/2025 at 00:00 CET. From that time, all scores will be put into that new leaderboard, and you'll have the chance to snatch the top guard achievement.

~ Jiri
